title: Wild Savanna
palette: sun-dried ochre grass, red earth, soft sage acacias, violet distant mesas, apricot sky
scene: An original vast untamed savanna at first-person eye level, evoking the emotional scale of a classic 16-bit wild continent without recreating any game location. A broad red-earth animal trail begins at bottom center and winds left through tawny grass toward distant violet mesas. A few flat-topped acacia trees with sculptural dark trunks, wind-worn ochre boulders, a low ridge and a huge luminous apricot-blue sky. Not desert dunes. Expansive quiet wilderness, no animals or people, a continuous obvious traversable ground route.
wall: flat weathered ochre sandstone with broad quiet cracks and earth-red stains
floor: flat dusty terracotta earth with small warm pebbles and fine dry cracks
secondary: flat short sun-dried tawny savanna grass groundcover with muted olive undergrowth
detail: flat gray-brown acacia bark with fine irregular grooves and subtle pale lichen
concept_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production biome concept for Recurant, a first-person fantasy exploration game. Create a gorgeous refined painterly pixel-art landscape in the spirit of richly colored early-1990s Lands of Lore environments, with deliberate pixel clusters, elegant atmospheric color and warm/cool relationships; not muddy, not cheap flat vector art, not photorealism. Landscape 4:3 composition, intended native 320x240 pixels with readable clusters. Full image, no frame, UI, text, labels, signatures, logos, people, creatures, weapons or first-person hands. Clearly navigable floor, eye-height first-person view, no aerial or isometric camera. Original composition, do not copy any existing game or card image. Palette: sun-dried ochre grass, red earth, soft sage acacias, violet distant mesas, apricot sky. atlas_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual diffuse material texture atlas for a low-resolution first-person fantasy game, NOT concept art. Produce exactly ONE square image divided precisely into a 2 by 2 grid of FOUR equal borderless square texture swatches, filling every pixel. TOP LEFT: flat weathered ochre sandstone with broad quiet cracks and earth-red stains. TOP RIGHT: flat dusty terracotta earth with small warm pebbles and fine dry cracks. BOTTOM LEFT: flat short sun-dried tawny savanna grass groundcover with muted olive undergrowth. BOTTOM RIGHT: flat gray-brown acacia bark with fine irregular grooves and subtle pale lichen. Each is a distinct close-up FLAT ORTHOGRAPHIC SURFACE, not an object, scene, panel, cube, tile slab or perspective floor. Material surfaces alone; absolutely no horizon, scenery, shadow-casting objects, bevelled borders, text, labels, frame, gutters, gaps or margin. Neutral even ambient illumination across each square; no vignette, bright center or directional gradient. Quiet low-frequency painterly pixel texture and intentional hand-painted clusters, refined rich early-1990s fantasy color, intended to downsample crisply to 256x256 per swatch. Palette: sun-dried ochre grass, red earth, soft sage acacias, violet distant mesas, apricot sky. All four swatches should tile seamlessly on their own along both axes: match corresponding opposite edges, avoid singular center motifs, keep detail small and distributed, continue organic patterns across boundaries. Each quadrant must remain entirely its own material, sharp boundary exactly at the 50% horizontal and vertical midpoint. Do not depict four scenic landscapes. Do not paint objects on a background. Original work.
